# Review, pass 1: kebra-nagast-ch13-16 (ch. 13–16)

Method: every unit read against the Geʿez, `l`, `i` and `n`; compared with `kebra-nagast-ch1.json`, `-ch2-8.json`, `-ch9-12.json`. Dillmann was not available and no modern translation was opened. All edits were made to `units.json` by script (exact-substring replacement, asserted unique). Checked afterward: 45 units, `t` of every unit unchanged, t-join equals the packet text (3351 characters, 473 words), all `p` flags and keys unchanged. `gloss.json` was not touched. Units are numbered from 0 in file order (0 = ch. 13 heading, 15 = ch. 14 heading, 26 = ch. 15, 29 = ch. 16).

## Counts

major 1 · moderate 9 · minor 25 · total 35 changes (51 field edits). Findings refused or kept: 14 (below).

## Changes

### Major

1. **U30 · l, i, n · major.** Wrong: `ተዐድዎ` (in `እስመ ኢርቱዕ ተዐድዎ ሕግ`) was parsed as perfect `ተዐደወ` + `-o` "it", and `ኢርቱዕ` as an adverb, giving "since not-rightly he-transgressed the law" / "he wrongly transgressed". The published ch. 11 reads the same construction `ኢርቱዕ ተዐዲዎ ማሕላ` as a verbal noun ("it was not right to overstep"), and ch. 13 here has the same form type in `ተሣይጦ`. Done: read `ተዐድዎ` as the verbal noun "the transgressing". `l` is now "since not (was) right the-transgressing (of) the-law which commanded God"; `i` is "for it was not right to transgress the law that God had commanded"; `n` explains this and marks the alternative reading (perfect plus -o, "they transgressed it") as uncertain.

### Moderate

2. **U3 · n · moderate.** Wrong: the note called `ዝሰ` "rare" and UNCERTAIN, saying we would expect `ዝንቱ`. `ዝ` is the ordinary short masculine demonstrative. Done: note rewritten as `ዝ` "this" + contrastive `-ሰ`; the false uncertainty is removed.
3. **U5 · i, n · moderate.** Wrong: `i` said "the hands of a craftsman made", but `እደ` is the construct of singular `እድ` "hand" (`l` already said "the-hand-of"). The note invented a plural-subject-after-verb problem. Done: `i` is now "which a craftsman's hand made?"; the note says `እደ` is the singular construct (plural `እደው`, as in the next unit but one) and the `-o` is resumptive.
4. **U5 · l, i, n · moderate.** House rendering: ch. 9–12 renders `ብርት` as "bronze" (`i` and glossary); this unit had "brass". Done: "bronze(?)" in `l`, "bronze" in `i`; note points to ch. 9–12 and keeps the uncertainty about the exact metal.
5. **U6 · l, n · moderate.** Wrong: `አበይዎ` is 3rd plural (`አበዩ` + `-o`), so the buyers are the subject. The note offered "Abram refused to sell" as a grammatical alternative, which a plural verb does not allow, and `l` dropped the `-o`. Done: `l` "And-they-refused-him buying from-Abram"; note states the plural form, the two ways to take `ለአብራም`, and the object-marking `ለ-` of `ለግልፈዋተ`. `i` unchanged (it was already right).
6. **U8 · l, n · moderate.** Wrong: `ዘአውሥእዎ` is 3rd plural ("they answered him"), not singular "he who answered him" as `l` had it. Done: `l` "And-there-was-not (one) who they-answered-him"; note explains the impersonal plural. `i` unchanged.
7. **U13 · n · moderate.** Wrong label: `አስተርአዮ` was explained as "ተአርየ passive-reflexive"; no such stem. It is `አስተርአየ`, the Ct stem of `ርእየ` (same stem as `ያስተርኢ` earlier in the unit), plus `-o`. Done: note corrected.
8. **U14 · l, i, n · moderate.** Wrong: `l` and `i` gave "it raised him ... it took the fear"; the verbs `አንሥኦ`, `ይቤሎ`, `አእተተ` are 3rd masculine singular with no stated subject, and a chariot cannot "say". Done: "he" in `l` and `i`; note says the subject is unstated, probably the one in the chariot, with the grammatical possibility of the (masculine) chariot marked uncertain.
9. **U17 · i · moderate.** `i` said "in the seventh generation", but `፯ ትውልድ` is a cardinal and the note itself says the grammar is open. Rebuilt from grammar: "in seven generations after you". Note says why.
10. **U17 · n · moderate.** Unflagged ambiguity: `ታንሶሱ` and `ትከውን` are both 3fs or 2ms; `i` takes the first as the Ark and the second as Abraham with no sign of the change. Done: UNCERTAIN added to the note (translation kept; "she (the Ark) will be a saviour" is possible).

### Minor

11. U2 · n: "ጣዖት ... (from Greek)" was unsupported (the word's origin is not known here). Replaced with "I do not know the word's origin".
12. U7 · n: `አበልዐ` corrected to `አብልዐ` (causative of `በልዐ`).
13. U8 · n: `አልቦ` was analysed as `ኢ + ቦ`; it is `አል-` "not" + `ቦ`. Corrected.
14. U10 · l: `ቦ ለዘ` rendered "there-was he-whom" with `ለ` and the `-o` suffixes dropped. Now "there-was for-him-who he-slapped-him ..." (transparent `l`; `i` unchanged).
15. U11 · n: `ታሐሥሙ` and `አሕሠመ` come from one root; note now says so and gives the literal sense. Still UNCERTAIN.
16. U12 · l: `አርአየ ገጾ` was "he-turned his-face"; now "he-showed his-face" (the note already gave "showed"; `i` keeps "turned" as English idiom).
17. U12 · n: `አምላኪየ` was analysed as `አምላክ + -ኪ- + -የ`, treating `ኪ` as a suffix; it is the noun's own final `ክ` with a linking vowel before `-የ`. Corrected.
18. U13 · i: "Creator of heaven and earth" (creed wording) for plural `ሰማያት`; now "the heavens and the earth", as in the published ch. 9–12.
19. U13 · n: added that `እግዚኦ` is `እግዚእ` + vocative `-ኦ` (not previously explained).
20. U19 · n: `አሰሐተ` corrected to `አስሐተ`.
21. U19 · n: the claim that plural `-ሙ` in `እሁቦሙ` "covers the lands" was stated as fact; now marked UNCERTAIN.
22. U23 · l: `ምሁራነ ፀብእ` is a construct; "trained-in war" changed to "trained-of war".
23. U23 · l: `የዐንቁ በዝጋናተ` dropped `በ-`; now "wear-at-the-neck with-collars of-gold".
24. U23 · n: numeral. Kept as printed (18, not 318) and flagged more explicitly: Genesis 14:14 has 318, the printed text has no `፫፻`, a dropped "300" is possible but not assumed.
25. U23 · n: `ዲባጋት (Persian-derived)` softened to "probably a Persian loanword".
26. U23 · n: `ዐንቀ` corrected to verb `ዐነቀ` from `ዐንቅ`, and the role of `በ-` stated.
27. U24, U27, U28, U35 · l (and U35 · i): house rendering of `አዕረፈ` is "rested" (ch. 2–12 in both `l` and `i`); `l` had "reposed" in four units and U35 `i` had "died". All now "rested" (the note on the double sense stays).
28. U25 · n: `ተለዐለ` was called "passive-reflexive of ላዕለ"; `ላዕለ` is a preposition. Now "the ተ- stem of a verb ለዐለ 'be high', from the root of ላዕል".
29. U27 · i: "Then his son Isaac reigned"; there is no "then" in the Geʿez. Now "And his son Isaac reigned".
30. U28 · l: `ኮነ ብዙኅ` is singular; "were-abundant" changed to "was many".
31. U30 · l: `ሮቤል በኰሩ ለያዕቆብ` shown as "the-firstborn-of Jacob" (hid the suffix and the genitive `ለ-`); now "his-firstborn of-Jacob".
32. U30 · n: `ዘአርኰሰ` glossed "he who defiled" under `በእንተ ዘ-` "because"; now "that he defiled".
33. U35 · l: `ኢሳሮም` was given as "Hezron" in `l`, where `l` should keep the Geʿez form (as Orni, Baos, Iyobed in neighbouring units); now "Isarom". `i` keeps Hezron.
34. U36 · i: "Orni" is not an English form; the note identifies Luke 3:33 Arni. `i` now "Arni" (`l` keeps Orni).
35. U37 · n: typo `ኣራም` for the source's `አራም`. Corrected.

## Findings refused or kept as drafted (with reason)

1. **U23 numeral 18 vs 318**: kept as printed (`ዐሠርተ ወሰመንተ`), flagged in the note per instruction; `l` and `i` say ten-and-eight, "eighteen".
2. **U1 who names Abram**: already marked UNCERTAIN in the note; no better reading available.
3. **U6 `አርኰሰ` "defile" vs the smashing that follows**: marked uncertain in the note; consistent with its use of Reuben in U30; no evidence for a better sense.
4. **U6 `ግልፈዋተ` "carved images"** and **U9 `ጸዐለ`**, **U11 `ታሐሥሙ`**, **U31 `ዝልጉሳነ ወዕቡቃነ`** ("feeble and contemptible"), **U5 `ኬንያ` "craftsman"**: all already flagged uncertain in the notes; Dillmann not available, so no change.
5. **U33 wordplay guess** (Judah / `ተሀይደ`): already labelled as my guess, not text; kept.
6. **U43 `ዘእቤ`**: reading "which I speak of" already flagged UNCERTAIN; kept.
7. **U13 "As for my God — be my God, you"**: `አምላኪየሰ ኩነኒ አንተ` is a left-dislocated topic; `i` is acceptable; kept.
8. **U20 `ሰማያት` → "heaven" in `i`** (and "heavens" in `l`): explained in the note; kept (U13 `i` changed to "heavens" only where the creator formula lists plural nouns, per published ch. 9–12).
9. **U24 `ይመውእ` as past**: imperfects in narrative are rendered as past or habitual throughout the published parts; kept.
10. **U35–U42 `l` names (Perez, Sala, Orni ...)**: published `l` already mixes conventional and Geʿez forms (Peleg, Ragau, Seruh); only the clear outlier (Hezron) was changed; `ፋሬስ` "Perez" kept on the Peleg precedent; `ሳላ` "Salmon" in `i` kept (Matthew/Ruth, as the note says; differs from ch. 9 Sala = Shelah).
11. **U18 "after him"**: antecedent (Abraham) is clear from context; kept.
12. **U7 note "standard Jewish-Christian tale"**: not a grammatical claim and outside what I can check; kept.
13. **Lower-case `and` openings in `i` (U3, U33 etc.)**: consistent with the published parts' `i`; kept.
14. **Repeated first-occurrence notes (ወ-, ከመ + subjunctive, -ሰ)**: ch. 2–12 already introduced them; repeating once more here is harmless; kept.

# Review, pass 2: kebra-nagast-ch13-16 (ch. 13–16)

Method: every one of the 255 novel entries in `gloss.json` and the 4 `__broaden__` entries read against the Geʿez, against the unit's `l`/`i`/`n`, against `conventions.md` and against the published glossaries (`kebra-nagast-ch1.json`, `-ch2-8.json`, `-ch9-12.json`) for lemma and notation precedent; all 45 units re-read. Dillmann not available, no modern translation opened. Edits made by script (`gloss.json` and `units.json` rewritten with the same layout). Checked afterwards: `t` of every unit and every `p` flag unchanged; t-join equals the packet; every key of `novel-forms.json` still present in `gloss.json`; every non-broaden value contains " — "; each broaden value begins with the published entry whole and " · ". Proclitics checked key by key: the only ወ-initial key whose ወ is a root letter is ወገሮ (root ወገረ 'pelt'), and it is correct against the sense (ወቦ ለዘ ወገሮ ወሰበሮ: the second ወ, before ሰበሮ, is 'and'); ወወድቀ, ወወሰደ, ወወፅአ, ወእሁቦሙ, ወወሀቦ are ወ- + root-initial ወ and are right.

## Counts

major 0 · moderate 7 · minor 28 · total 35 changes (28 gloss.json values, 5 units.json fields in 4 units). Kept or refused: 11 (below).

## Changes

### Moderate

1. **ወታንሶሱ · lemma · moderate.** Wrong: lemma `ነሶሰወ`, a non-causative verb, cannot give the prefix `ታ-` (the published ch. 2–12 entry for the same verb is `ታንሶሱ` → `አንሶሰወ`, quadriliteral). Done: lemma `አንሶሰወ`, published notation; the 2ms alternative from the unit note is stated in the entry.
2. **እምዛቲ · lemma · moderate.** Wrong: lemma `እም` (the proclitic) for `እም-` + `ዛቲ`; the popup would parse the preposition and lose the demonstrative (cf. published `ወዛቲ` → `ዛቲ`, and `እምፍኖት` → `ፍኖት` here). Done: lemma `ዛቲ`.
3. **ወቦሙ · lemma and meaning · moderate.** Wrong: parsed as existential `ቦ` "there is to them". In U24 (`ወቦሙ ይመውእ ፀሮ`, `l` "with-them", the note "ቦ- in/with") it is the preposition `በ-` with the 3mp suffix, ቦሙ, the counterpart of `ሎሙ` = `ለ-` + `ሙ`. Done: lemma `በ`, "and with them".
4. **በኰሩ · grammar · moderate.** Wrong: "construct 'firstborn of'". Pass 1 (change 31) fixed `l`/`n` to "his firstborn, Jacob's" (suffix -u plus the `ለ-` genitive); the gloss still contradicted them. Done: "his firstborn (noun + -u 'his')".
5. **ወአንሥኦ · meaning · moderate.** Wrong: "and it raised him". Pass 1 (change 8) made `l`/`i` "he" because the subject is unstated and a chariot does not raise; the gloss kept "it". Done: "and he raised him … subject not stated"; root also in the published `n-ś-ʾ`.
6. **በ፯ · numeral · moderate.** Wrong: "in the 7th … ordinal 'seventh'", the reading pass 1 (change 9) removed from `i` and `n` (`፯` is a cardinal; "in seven generations"). Also the lemma carried the proclitic. Done: lemma `፯`, spoken `በሰብዐቱ (bä-säbʿätu)` "in seven", cardinal stated, per the conventions' numeral form.
7. **__broaden__ ሳላ · moderate.** Wrong: the added reading said the Davidic Sala is "the same name … rendered Salmon", and the old entry calls Sala "Shelah"; Shelah (Genesis 11) and Salmon (Ruth 4:20) are different people. Done: old entry whole + " · in the Davidic line (ch. 16) the Salmon of Ruth 4:20 and Matthew 1:4–5, whom Luke 3:32 calls Sala; a different person from Shelah" (matches the U40 note).

### Minor

8. ወተባረከ, ወተባረኩ, ይትባረክ · lemma: published `ተባረከ` has lemma `ባረከ` ("passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ"); these three used `ተባረከ`. Now `ባረከ`, same notation.
9. ይሢጥ, ይትባረክ · grammar: "jussive" after `ከመ`; the notes call it subjunctive. Now "subjunctive after ከመ".
10. ፃእ · lemma: `ወጽአ` (ጸ) against published and local `ወፅአ`; now `ወፅአ`.
11. አስትዩኒ · lemma: `አስትየ`; the perfect is `አስተየ` (and the U7 note says so). Now `አስተየ`.
12. ዘአውሥእዎ, ወነሥኣ · root notation: `w-š-ʾ`, `n-s-ʾ` for ሠ; now `w-ś-ʾ`, `n-ś-ʾ` (conventions ś = ሠ; published uses ś).
13. አሕሠመ, ወኢታሐሥሙ · root and meaning: root written `ḥ-s-m` (the text has ሠ, so `ḥ-ś-m`); ወኢታሐሥሙ was given only "requite" with no link to the verb of harming that the note (U11) and `አሕሠመ` assume. Now both stated, stem still marked uncertain.
14. ወጸዐሎሙ · the note says UNCERTAIN, the gloss gave no hint; added "root and sense uncertain".
15. አስተሐቀርኩክሙ · "I despised" against `l`/`i` "I despise"; transliteration `ʾastäḥaqqärä` had an unexplained `a` and gemination. Now "I despised, I despise", Ct stem, no invented transliteration.
16. ርእስክሙ · "yourselves" with "-ክሙ '2mp'" unclear; now "'head' used reflexively + -ክሙ '2mp your'".
17. ቅድሜሁ · lemma `ቅድሜ`, not a dictionary form (published `ቅድመ`, as `ድኅሬሁ` → `ድኅረ`). Now `ቅድመ`.
18. ወፈለሰት + U30 `l`, `i` · "passed away" suggests dying; `ፈለሰ` is 'migrate, pass over'. Gloss "passed, moved away"; U30 `l` "and-passed the-kingdom", `i` "the kingdom passed from him".
19. ኦርኒ · "the Ram/Arni": Ram is the next king (አራም) and the note says only Arni of Luke 3:33. Now "Arni of Luke 3:33".
20. መድኀኒተ · "saviour, salvation" without saying which; now "salvation, saviour (… predicate …)", agreeing with the published `መድኀኒት`.
21. ወትከውን · now says the letters are also 3fs, as the note (pass 1 change 10) says of the pair.
22. ለግልፈዋተ · lemma `ግልፈት` sits against the note's `ግልፍ`; neither can be checked, so the entry now says the singular and exact sense are uncertain (and keeps the object-marking `ለ-`).
23. ወተሞገሰ, ወተለዐለ · invented gemination in the transliterations (`tämoggäsä`, `tä-läʿʿälä`); now without.
24. __broaden__ ኢኮነ · published "he did not become" only; this use is predicative "this is not a god". Added " · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ …; ch. 13)".
25. __broaden__ እንዘ · published "while, whilst" only; U32 is concessive ("although he himself was firstborn"). Added.
26. U2 · n: "ሎቱ = ለ- + -ሁ"; the suffix is -ቱ. Corrected.
27. U5 · n: "ዘትሣየጡ (ተሣየጠ)" disagreed with the gloss and with `ይሠይጥ`; now "root ś-y-ṭ, as in ይሠይጥ above and ተሣይጦ below".
28. U28 · n: quoted "'were many his goods and his sons'" after pass 1 made `l` "was many". Now "was many".

## Kept or refused (with reason)

1. **ዘትሣየጡ lemma `ሣየጠ`, ይሠይጥ/ይሢጥ lemma `ሠይጠ`**: the relation between ሠይጠ, ሣየጠ and ተሣየጠ cannot be settled without Dillmann; left, root now consistent in the note.
2. **ወይትቄጸሉ lemma `ተቄጸለ`**: the verb may be `ቀጸለ` (ቀጸላ 'wreath') with a variant spelling; no way to check; left, sense is right from context.
3. **ተሀይደ, ዝልጉሳነ, ዕቡቃነ, ዲባጋተ, ዝጋና, ወየዐንቁ, ኬንያ**: lemmas unverifiable; each already marked uncertain in gloss and note; left.
4. **ረገፆ lemma `ረገጸ`**: the text spells ፀ; dictionary form kept with ጸ; left.
5. **ያአትዎሙ lemma `አአተወ`**: the spelling `አእተወ` may be standard; unverifiable; left.
6. **፲ወ፪ ዓመተ, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ**: masculine citation forms; ዓመት is feminine and a feminine spoken form may be expected; the convention gives no gender rule; left.
7. **፲ወ፭ (published) `ḫaməstu`**: ኀ is first order, so `ḫäməstu` by convention; the entry is in a published part (known-forms) and is not ours to change; noted for the series owner.
8. **ለዘ "(to/of the one) whom"**: vague but not wrong (ለ- is object marker or dative; both readings fit the resumptive -o); left.
9. **ጸፍዖ, ረገፆ, ወገሮ, ሰበሮ "him" for idols**: matches the note (idols treated as persons).
10. **ዘኢያድኅን / ኢታድኅኑ rendered "cannot save" in `i`**: interpretive but idiomatic; `l` is literal; left.
11. **U19 "give it" in `i` against ወእሁቦሙ "them"**: already flagged UNCERTAIN in the note; left.
